title: agent-status state.json
description: The agents' current state, as the agent-status daemon writes it. Read only: send events through the FIFO. Times are milliseconds since the Unix epoch. A reader checks schema_version: a new field keeps the version, a removed or changed field raises it.

daemon.description: Which daemon wrote the file, and whether events are arriving.

sessions.description: One entry per agent session, keyed by session_id.

harness.description: The agent, such as claude or pi. May be empty.

pid.description: 0 when the agent gave none: the session never dies.

dead_since.description: Set when state is dead; the session is removed 5 minutes later.

message.description: At most a few hundred bytes; never a prompt or a tool's input.

reason.description: What set state: event:<name>, event:unknown(<name>), declared:<state> or liveness:pid_gone.

tmux_socket.description: The socket of the tmux server the pane belongs to.

tmux_session.description: The tmux session name of the pane.

window_index.description: The tmux window index of the pane.

window_name.description: The tmux window name of the pane.

meta.description: What the enrich run read from the transcript, directory and git; absent until it runs.

declared.description: Absent unless the agent declared done or error in the current turn; it becomes the state when the turn ends.
